release_notes:
FocusShield Engine v1.4.4:
• YouTube Selective Interception: Blocks distracting YouTube channels (gaming, roasting, entertainment) and YouTube Shorts in real-time while preserving full access to educational study lectures (Physics Wallah, NCERT, Khan Academy, Vedantu).
• Strict OEM Pop-up Protection: Added active AppOps verification (OP_BACKGROUND_START_ACTIVITY 10021) for Xiaomi/HyperOS, Vivo/FuntouchOS, and ColorOS to guarantee instant foreground activity starts.
• 0ms Instant Slate Visual Trampoline over restricted apps before gate launch.
• High-craft tactile YouTube restriction screen with quick switch to Universal Study Mode.
